event_summary: A handheld camera moves from a close view of a translucent curved object with rainbow light bands to a wider view of a wooden tabletop with a bright rectangular light patch and a dark horizontal edge above it.
raw_event_description: At the start, the frame is filled by a pale translucent curved object and bright curved rainbow-like bands across a gray surface. As the view changes, more of the object's rim and edge appear, then the object shifts out of the frame area due to camera movement. The later view shows a wooden tabletop with a bright rectangular patch near the upper left and a dark horizontal band across the top. Near the end, a pale curved rim reappears near the top edge of the frame.

reasons: The initial view is a close-up with only part of the translucent curved object visible.
The surrounding tabletop and upper dark edge are not yet fully visible.
Bright curved light bands occupy much of the frame.
